name: AI Model & ML Storage Cleaner
author: WinCare Core Team
description: Specialized storage cleaner for machine learning weights, checkpoints, and blobs across HuggingFace, Whisper, Ollama, PyTorch Hub, Keras, and LM Studio.

tools.title: Hugging Face Model Cache
tools.summary: Cleans downloaded models, transformer weights, and snapshots from ~/.cache/huggingface/hub.

tools.title: Ollama Model Blobs
tools.summary: Scans and cleans unused LLM blobs and manifests from ~/.ollama/models.

tools.title: PyTorch Hub Weights
tools.summary: Removes cached torchvision and hub neural net checkpoints from ~/.cache/torch/hub/checkpoints.

tools.title: LM Studio & Local LLM Caches
tools.summary: Cleans GPU shader cache, code cache, and temporary conversation checkpoints from LM Studio, Cherry Studio, and Jan.
